# Mobile plans: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Call-data records must be kept for twelve months, as the Telecom Licence requires. |
| C2 | Customers must be told of a price rise 30 days before it takes effect, under Consumer Code 4. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a subscriber, I want to see my data usage for the month so that I avoid overage.
US-2 As a subscriber, I want a notice a month before my price goes up so that I can switch if I do not like it.
US-3 As a subscriber, I want to top up my balance by card so that I never run out.
